headlines.text: On this day in 2025, Kyle Fletcher vs. Tomohiro Ishii went to battle over the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 8.14 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. In his first defense since dethroning Rhodes, Fletcher weathered Ishii's brutal chops to retain the TNT Championship.
Flash back to 2023, when Rob Van Dam made their first appearance under the AEW banner in a FTW Rules match against Jack Perry, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.82.
On this day in 2024, it marked the first-ever meeting between Wheeler Yuta and Rocky Romero on Rampage, rated 6.75.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2025, when JetSpeed & Page announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.25 ? a strong outing.
It was 2025 when it marked the first-ever meeting between Ricochet and Juice Robinson on Collision, rated 5.79.
It was 2023 when Hikaru Shida vs. Anna Jay went to battle over the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.65.
